subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the sales of two wheelers from three different branches of a company during two consecutive years 2018 and 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0e57c216a33e0c188ee93b582f826604a7d38ce450a6135931d4caa297d8290.png] 

What is the average sale of all the branches in the year 2019?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Average = total of observation/number of observations

**Calculation:**

Average = (1900 + 2100 + 1100)/3

⇒ 1700

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
